purpose: Evidence-driven comparison of NativeAgentRuntimeV2 vs LangGraphParityRuntimeV2 for default promotion readiness
basis: 08F5 observability inventory, 08F4-R2 technical patch audit, 08F1/08F4/08E smoke tests, source inspection at 6ecc495

comparison.langgraph: create_run, execute_run, get_run, list_runs, get_trace present; plan_run, pause_run, resume_run, cancel_run not implemented
comparison.evidence: native_runtime.py:46-505 implements all 9 methods. langgraph_parity_runtime.py inspection shows no plan_run/pause_run/resume_run/cancel_run methods.

comparison.langgraph: run.json + CheckpointStore + TraceStore under caller-provided run_root (defaults to runs_parity)
comparison.evidence: Both use CheckpointStore and TraceStore; both persist run.json. 08F1 contract tests verify schema stability.

comparison.native: TraceStore events per step, provider metadata, mode escalation
comparison.langgraph: TraceStore events per graph node plus capability_metadata node; node_path included
comparison.evidence: 08F5 observability inventory shows LangGraph nodes emit trace events and capability metadata; node_path gives deterministic step sequence.

comparison.native: CheckpointStore.save at status changes; pause_run/resume_run exist
comparison.langgraph: Checkpoints at step_index 0 and 99; no pause_run/resume_run; resume path unverified
comparison.evidence: native_runtime.py has pause_run/resume_run. langgraph_parity_runtime.py only saves checkpoints in _save_checkpoint; no resume method.

comparison.native: Governance gate inside execute_run; mode escalation recorded
comparison.langgraph: Governance gate as graph node; mode_effective escalation to approval_required while preserving mode_requested=auto
comparison.evidence: 08F4-R2 audit verified escalate_auto_mode_effective in governance.py and _governance_gate_node carries mode_effective forward.

comparison.native: Try/except around _load_run and execute_run; returns failed status
comparison.langgraph: Graph-level timeout/circuit-breaker; malformed run state handling; invalid backend fallback
comparison.evidence: 08F4-R2 verified timeout, malformed_run_state, and auto escalation fixes in langgraph_parity_runtime.py.

comparison.native: No explicit timeout in Native execute_run
KeyError if run.json missing; load failure may raise
Governance validate_mode + infer_auto_decision; mode escalation recorded

comparison.langgraph: runtime.py falls back to Native on invalid env, missing package, init failure, missing production methods
comparison.evidence: 08F5 observability inventory and 08E runtime selector guard tests verify fallback.

comparison.langgraph: API adapter exposes backend metadata; dashboard status route returns backend; backend_fallback_reason not shown in dashboard
comparison.evidence: 08F5 risk_and_gap_register notes GAP-08F5-04: dashboard does not expose backend_fallback_reason.

comparison.native: 08E selector guard (14 tests), dashboard token fix (3 tests)
phase1-ci and nontrading-smoke-regression green with Native default
comparison.langgraph: Same CI runs green; LangGraph-specific tests require AGENT_V2_BACKEND=langgraph locally or in CI matrix
comparison.evidence: 08F5 CI green. CI matrix for LangGraph-specific tests not yet documented as a separate job.

comparison.native: Single Python class; linear flow; easy to debug
comparison.langgraph: Graph with 14 nodes; higher conceptual overhead; requires LangGraph package expertise
comparison.evidence: native_runtime.py is ~505 lines. langgraph_parity_runtime.py is ~1334 lines plus graph wiring.

comparison.native: Stable, proven, but harder to extend to multi-agent/human-in-the-loop
comparison.langgraph: Designed for durable execution, stateful workflows, human interrupts, sub-agent orchestration
comparison.evidence: LangGraph OSS primitives (graph nodes, checkpoints, interrupts) map directly to Brain's agentic roadmap items.

comparison.langgraph: Graph nodes can host sub-agent calls; future multi-agent roles fit naturally
comparison.evidence: LangGraph suite adoption plan Layer 4 identifies future roles (Memory Curator, Governance Auditor, etc.).

comparison.native: MemoryGatewayV2 used directly; no explicit evidence-linking
comparison.langgraph: memory_retrieval node; capability metadata tracks retrieval; evidence routing node exists
Governance gate as explicit graph node; SUPPORTED_READ_TOOLS whitelist; blocked_tools tracked

blockers_for_default: C-01 Runtime contract completeness: LangGraph missing plan_run, pause_run, resume_run, cancel_run
C-04 Checkpoint/resume readiness: no pause/resume methods, resume path unverified

overall_assessment: LangGraph is structurally better aligned with Brain's long-term agentic orchestration goals, but it is not yet a production-complete replacement for Native. Two blocking gaps must be closed before default promotion can be considered.
